title: BUILDReturn
description: The independent BUILD acceptance determination for a completed evidence package. Only the assigned BUILD authority produces this. Bob/implementation actors must not fabricate or self-issue a BUILDReturn. determination must be explicit — no implicit default may produce 'accepted'.

plan_hash.description: Immutable plan identity this return is bound to.

target_build_id.description: Exact build identity this return is bound to. Cannot be substituted.

build_authority_id.description: Identity of the independent BUILD authority. Must not be fabricated or defaulted.

determination.description: Explicit determination. No implicit default may produce 'accepted'. Implementation actors must not self-issue.

evidence_package_ref.description: Hash reference to the evidence package this determination is based on.
